stem: A plot of land near Multan, Pakistan, was valued at 5,000,000 rupees in 2024. The value of the plot is expected to increase by \(10\%\) each year. According to this expectation, what will the value of the plot be, in rupees, in 2026?
solution: A \(10\%\) increase each year multiplies the value by \(1.1\) each year.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the value after only 1 year, \(5{,}000{,}000(1.1)\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This adds \(10\%\) of the original value twice (\(20\%\) in all). The second year's \(10\%\) is taken of the larger 2025 value.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This uses a factor of \(1.22\) instead of \(1.1^{2} = 1.21\).

verify:
v = 5000000*Rational(11, 10)**2
assert v == 6050000
assert value(choices[answer]) == v
assert all(value(choices[k]) != v for k in choices if k != answer)
